name: PDF to XLS
summary: Extracts PDF text with poppler and writes a quick Excel workbook for rough table recovery.
story: Somebody always sends the numbers as a PDF. This is the little bridge from inert document to spreadsheet-shaped thing I can sort, inspect, and use.

launcher.long: Pulls tabular data out of a PDF and writes it to a spreadsheet — handy for statements, reports, and invoices that only come as PDFs.
